fields.label: Claimed Amount
fields.description: The amount the user CLAIMS to have transferred externally. This is never auto-credited to their wallet — see status. Only what the admin actually approves is what gets credited, via _credit() at approval time, not this field being trusted directly.

fields.label: Payment Number
fields.description: Which of the admin's real receiving numbers the user claims to have sent to — for the admin's own manual reconciliation against their actual bank/wallet statements.

fields.label: Reference Note
fields.description: Optional free-text the user can supply (e.g. a transaction reference id from their banking app) to help the admin reconcile.

fields.label: Admin Note
fields.description: Set by the admin on rejection (or approval) — e.g. why a claimed transfer couldn't be matched.
